lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: Lose GPS during a walk, including while a point owns manual controls, then restore it; recording stays active, the first usable fix appends automatically and the point lock remains; a manually paused walk must remain paused across the same loss/recovery and sticky restart
Start a new line or polygon walk and immediately Finish with insufficient distinct vertices; verify the readable no-save message, no new feature/form and released walk owner
Press the disk on a valid new or existing walk, cancel once and confirm; verify the acknowledged final geometry immediately opens attributes with no premature row write
Inspect the single 48dp themed row with only layer name, disk, pause/play and cross, three 48dp targets, long-press and accessibility names; cancel each confirmation and verify the owner is retained

Confirm Pause, supply fresh fixes and verify geometry does not grow; cancel Resume once, then confirm reconnection and verify the same owner records again; acquire a point lock while a confirmation is open and verify the queued command is rejected
Start current-location or new walk creation from a distant map extent; verify map target matches the actual GPS geometry anchor, zoom is unchanged and cancelled category selection does not pan
Expand creation actions, rotate and use large fonts; verify the panel moves clear of the actions and returns to the bottom after collapse
Recreate edit menus and toggle different actions; active Save and other enabled icons remain fully opaque
On Android 14+ deny Bluetooth permissions but grant fine location; start a walk using the system GNSS and verify its location-only foreground service and visible panel
Upgrade an installation with a retained failed walk session; inspect the panel, saved vertices and explicit Resume/Finish/Discard without erasing the draft
Enable background recording sound and start geometry-by-walk editing
Minimize notification volume while alarm volume remains audible, then mute alarm volume
Minimize the app, stand still for at least 35 seconds, then walk until several geometry points are saved
Disable every location provider or block background location delivery and wait at least 20 seconds
Revoke location permission in Android settings while walk recording is active, then return to the app
Restore location permission and continue the retained walk draft
Pause and resume the app, then finish geometry
Disable background recording sound and repeat the minimized recording segment
value.expected: Geometry and editing state survive lifecycle transitions without duplicate reload. While minimized, fresh usable callbacks produce a short confirmation every 10 seconds even while stationary and independently of saved vertices. Notification volume does not suppress the alarm-stream tone; muted alarm volume produces short vibration instead. The heartbeat stops after callbacks become stale; foreground and disabled-setting recording stay silent. Permission revocation causes no crash or forbidden location-FGS restart and the walk draft remains available after permission is restored.
